credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Eliot Porter, Doris Bry and Georgia O'Keeffe looking down at a pile of river rocks on the waters edge. Bry is kneeling, Porter is looking down with his camera on his shoulder and O'Keeffe is writing something in a notebook.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Doris Bry, Eliot Porter, and Georgia O'Keeffe
